For NR-U cell configured with supplementary uplink on the unlicensed spectrum, power headroom for both uplink carriers should be reported. 2. Actions: To RAN2 ACTION: RAN1 respectfully asks RAN2 to take the above agreement into consideration.. 3. Date of Next TSG-RAN2 Meetings: RAN1#100 24-28 Feb 2020 Athens, GR RAN1#100-Bis 20‑24 Apr 2020 Busan, Korea

3GPP TSG RAN WG1 Meeting #98bis R1-1911745 Chongqing, China, October 14th – 20th, 2019 Title: LS on Rel-16 LTE and NR parameter lists Response to: - Release: Rel-16 Work Items: LTE_eMTC5-Core, NB_IOT_enh3-Core, LTE_DL_MIMO_EE-Core, LTE_terr_bcast-Core, NR_2step_RACH-Core, NR_unlic-Core, NR_IAB-Core, 5G_V2X_NRSL-Core, NR_L1enh_URLLC-Core, NR_IIOT-Core, NR_eMIMO-Core, NR_UE_pow_sav-Core, NR_pos-Core, NR_Mob_enh-Core, LTE_NR_DC_CA_enh-Core Source: RAN WG1 To: RAN WG2, RAN WG3 CC: Contact Person: Name: Fred TAKEDA E-mail Address: ktakeda@qti.qualcomm.com Attachment: R1-1911743.zip (Consolidated parameter list for Rel-16 NR) R1-1911744.zip (Consolidated parameter list for Rel-16 LTE) 1. Overall Description: RAN1 has agreed a list of new higher-layer parameters and updates on existing higher-layer parameters for Rel.16 work items. Following are some notes regarding the list: For the work item “NR_Mob_enh-Core”, RAN1 has not identified necessary RRC parameters for now. For the work item “NR_CLI_RIM-Core”, RRC parameters for CLI-handling were already informed (e.g., by the LS R1-1903836). Therefore, the list of parameters for CLI and RIM is not included in the attached spread sheet. Necessary higher-layer parameter for NR Rel.16 TEI is also included in the sheet. For this parameter, the column for the WI code is denoted as “R16_TEI”. RAN1 is still discussing some parameters, which are highlighted by red color, with square bracket, or marked as FFS, TBC/TBD, etc. In addition, RAN1 may find additional necessary parameters. RAN1 will continue working on consolidating them and will share updates with RAN2 and RAN3 in November meeting. 2. Actions: To RAN WG2 and RAN WG3 ACTION: RAN1 kindly would like to ask RAN2 and RAN3 to design the corresponding higher-layer parameters in Rel.16. 3. Date of Next RAN WG1 Meetings: TSG-RAN WG1 Meeting #99 18th – 22th Nov 2019 US. TSG-RAN WG
